title: Found out, heard, assumed
summary: Say how you know what you say: `-dY` for what you saw, `-(Y)pdYr` in every person for what you found out or heard (*Sen üýtgäpsiň!*, *Ol gelipdir*), *eken* after verbs to report it (*Myhmanlar ertir geljek eken*), and `-dYr` for a confident guess (*Ol öýdedir*, *Eýýäm gelendir*).
canDo: Say what you have only just realized about yourself or someone else
Choose between what you saw and what you found out or heard
Pass on news and plans you have heard about
Make a confident guess about where someone is or what has happened
